Lemma
[extension of a tangent vector to a vector field]

On a smooth ($\sigma $-compact, Hausdorff) manifold, every tangent vector $v\in T_pM$ is the value at $p$ of a globally defined smooth vector field.
Proof

\sketch Extend $v$ as a constant-coefficient field in a chart at $p$, then multiply by a smooth bump function supported in the chart and equal to $1$ near $p$. Extension by zero is a global smooth field with value $v$ at $p$.

□
